DIE_STATE_ROOT.role: Mutable non-MUXIA DIE runtime/data root; canonical state lives under <root>/state

DIE_CONFIG_ROOT.role: Protected host configuration/secrets root; never Git source

rules: All configured roots must be absolute.
DIE_HOME is source/canon only; mutable state must resolve from DIE_STATE_ROOT.
DIE_CONFIG_ROOT must not be committed or used as an artifact source.
DIE_INSTALL_ROOT is regenerable from source and must not become canonical state.
Windows defaults preserve the current C:\DIE deployment until controlled cutover.
Linux defaults implement the Chapter #4 source/runtime/config separation.
